task.question: Who replaced José Jerí as president of Peru in February 2026?
task.evidence: February 17 – Peruvian president José Jerí was censured by Congress and replaced by José María Balcázar.

answer: José María Balcázar replaced José Jerí as president of Peru in February 2026 after Jerí was removed from office by Congress. Balcázar, a leftist politician, was elected by Congress to serve as the interim president. FINAL: José María Balcázar.
